content:
cd pcre2
./autogen.sh
./configure --enable-fuzz-support --enable-never-backslash-C --with-match-limit=1000 --with-match-limit-recursion=1000
make -j$(nproc) clean
make -j$(nproc) all
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -o $OUT/pcre2_fuzzer     -lFuzzingEngine .libs/libpcre2-fuzzsupport.a .libs/libpcre2-8.a
/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh
/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/honggfuzz/posix/arch.c
/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/libpcre2-posix.pc.in
/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/doc/html/pcre2posix.html
/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/doc/pcre2posix.3
/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2posix.h

/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2posix.c
